body.name: \mathscr L_f
body.def:
For a mass-zero input \(e\), \(\mathscr L_f e\) is the unique mean-zero solution \(v\) of \(-\operatorname{div}((D^2\varphi_f)^{-1}
abla v)=e(
abla\varphi_f)/f(
abla\varphi_f)\) on \(\Omega\), with homogeneous conormal boundary condition for the outward unit normal on \(\partial\Omega\).
